Name: Kenneth's Vanilla Machines Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b]Kenneth's Vanilla Machines Addon[/b]

[b]Tired of grinding for rare machines? Buy them all directly at Kenneth's Grocery Store![/b]

[b]What it does:[/b]
[b]⚙️ 22 Vanilla Machines & Equipment added to Kenneth's Grocery Store (Shop 2) - all year-round![/b]

[b]Includes:[/b]

[b]Artisan Machines:[/b]
[b]Keg, Preserves Jar, Cheese Press, Mayonnaise Machine, Loom, Oil Maker, Bee House, Cask, Dehydrator, Fish Smoker[/b]

[b]Utility Machines:[/b]
[b]Furnace, Charcoal Kiln, Crystalarium, Lightning Rod, Recycling Machine, Seed Maker, Worm Bin, Heater, Hopper[/b]

[b]💰 Balanced prices - Common machines at vanilla price, rare machines expensive with limited stock (3 only) for balance![/b]

[b]Perfect for:[/b]
[b]• Players who want to skip crafting grind
• Setting up big artisan farms quickly
• Getting rare Joja / Skull Cavern machines without RNG
• Late-game convenience

[/b][b]Requirements:[/b]
[b]• Kenneth's Grocery Store (Required)
• Content Patcher
• Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ 

[/b][b]Lightweight & Balanced - no new items, just vanilla machines in Kenneth's Grocery Store![/b]

Downloads.Description: Choose where you want the items to be sold. Only one file can be installed.
